title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch, Solid Brass Hardware - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop countertop clutter by adding storage and a towel spot right on the wall. This 16-inch glass shelf combines double-shelf organization with an integrated towel bar for everyday bathroom convenience.

  • Organize more in less space — double glass shelf design keeps toiletries and essentials within easy reach
  • Keep items secure — solid brass gallery rail helps prevent items from sliding off
  • Hang towels where you need them — integrated towel bar adds practical towel storage below the shelf
  • Built for daily use — 3/8-inch thick tempered glass paired with solid brass hardware
  • Clean wall presentation — concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs & Installation

  • Overall size: 16 in L x 5 in W x 12 in H (5-in projection)
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in), tempered glass
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Part of the Waverly Place collection—ideal for building a coordinated set of transitional bathroom hardware with matching Waverly Place accessories and grooved bathroom hardware details.
